title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, Product
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer, Product based in the United States.

The Senior Full Stack Engineer will play a key role in developing an innovative, AI-native platform designed to transform the global commercial construction industry. This position offers the opportunity to build impactful product experiences across sourcing, order tracking, payments, billing, and financial operations. The successful candidate will take ownership of complex product challenges, driving projects from initial discovery and design through development, deployment, and continuous improvement. Working closely with Product, Design, and Data Science teams, the engineer will create high-performance applications and intelligent AI-powered workflows. With a strong emphasis on React, TypeScript, and full-stack development, this role combines technical excellence with product thinking and customer impact. This is an exciting opportunity to join a high-performing, remote-first engineering team where autonomy, innovation, and rapid execution are highly valued.

Accountabilities

Own product engineering initiatives from initial concept and user research through architecture, development, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Data Science teams to identify customer needs, define solutions, establish priorities, and deliver meaningful product improvements.
Develop polished, responsive, accessible, and high-performance frontend experiences using React and TypeScript for owners, designers, vendors, and internal operations teams.
Build intuitive user interfaces that support complex, high-stakes business workflows, paying close attention to usability, navigation, visual hierarchy, loading states, error handling, and overall application performance.
Design, develop, and maintain backend APIs, schemas, services, and data contracts that support frontend functionality, ensuring reliable, explicit, and strongly typed system boundaries.
Build and maintain full-stack product features, taking responsibility for both frontend implementation and the underlying backend architecture.
Develop AI-powered and agentic user experiences, including workflows that combine autonomous AI actions with human approvals, reviews, and intervention when necessary.
Determine appropriate levels of AI autonomy within critical business processes, ensuring that automated decisions and human oversight are balanced effectively.
Contribute to the development of AI-driven workflows across sourcing, vendor discovery, order management, production tracking, shipping, payments, billing, and financial operations.
Apply AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex throughout the engineering lifecycle to accelerate prototyping, coding, testing, debugging, refactoring, and documentation.
Build reliable financial and payment-related systems with particular attention to correctness, idempotency, auditability, data integrity, and clearly defined failure-handling mechanisms.
Investigate and resolve production issues across the frontend, backend, APIs, and infrastructure while maintaining system reliability and performance.
Participate in customer conversations and support rotations to understand real-world challenges, gather feedback, and identify opportunities for product improvement.
Monitor product performance and customer outcomes, using data and business metrics to evaluate the impact of engineering decisions.
Help establish and improve frontend architecture, reusable components, design systems, and engineering standards.
Mentor fellow engineers, contribute to technical discussions, and promote a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, and engineering excellence.

Requirements

At least 6 years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of delivering customer-facing frontend and backend applications to production.
Advanced expertise in React and TypeScript, including state management, frontend architecture, design systems, component libraries, and user interface performance optimization.
Demonstrated ability to build responsive, accessible, intuitive, and high-quality user experiences, with strong attention to detail and usability.
Solid full-stack engineering experience, including designing, developing, and deploying REST or GraphQL APIs and managing the backend services and data contracts supporting product features.
Strong understanding of software architecture, API design, data structures, application performance, and production system reliability.
Practical experience using AI-powered development assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or comparable tools as part of everyday engineering workflows.
Ability to demonstrate how AI-assisted development tools have improved engineering productivity, accelerated delivery, or enhanced software quality.
Strong product mindset, with experience independently taking features or projects from initial discovery and concept through production release.
High level of ownership, initiative, and problem-solving ability, with the confidence to navigate ambiguity, overcome technical challenges, and deliver results without waiting for detailed instructions.
Ability to balance technical quality with business priorities, focusing on customer needs, product outcomes, and measurable impact rather than simply completing assigned tasks.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear technical documentation, design proposals, and code review comments.
Ability to explain technical decisions, architectural trade-offs, and complex engineering concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Strong collaboration skills and experience working effectively with cross-functional teams in remote or distributed environments.
Additional experience in one or more of the following areas is considered a significant advantage:
Building and deploying AI-powered applications or agentic workflows in production.
Implementing large language model (LLM) integrations, tool usage, evaluation frameworks, and human-in-the-loop review processes.
Working as an early-stage or founding engineer within a startup or fast-growing technology company.
Developing payment processing, billing, financial ledgers, payout systems, or other regulated financial products.
Designing and building scalable design systems or shared component libraries from the ground up.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Employment visa sponsorship is not currently available.

Benefits

Competitive annual base salary ranging from $190,000 to $220,000, depending on qualifications, experience, skills, education, and professional background.
Potential eligibility for discretionary performance-based bonuses and additional incentives based on individual and company performance.
Equity opportunities as part of the overall compensation package.
Employer-paid health insurance.
Comprehensive employee benefits and wellness support.
Flexible paid time off (PTO).
Fully remote working arrangement, with the flexibility to work from anywhere in the United States.
Professional development support and opportunities to expand technical expertise.
Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies and modern full-stack engineering tools.
Career growth opportunities within an ambitious, high-performing engineering team.
Collaborative and transparent working culture that encourages ownership, innovation, respect, and continuous improvement.
Opportunity to influence product architecture and build technology that transforms complex workflows across the global commercial construction industry.
Direct involvement in high-impact projects where engineering contributions can be measured through customer adoption and business growth.
